name: 01 · Capability & the wall
initialPrompt: Icon checklist (plan/code/API) with a struck credit-card — the agent can do everything except pay. (Scene split from “The Ledger Handshake”; no progress bar.)
scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:03 - 00:00:02:04  Your agent can plan, write code.
00:00:02:04 - 00:00:04:13  Call an API, but ask you to get real web data.
00:00:04:13 - 00:00:05:19  It just fails.
00:00:05:19 - 00:00:09:08  Yeah, it cannot sign up for an account or type in the credit card,
00:00:09:09 - 00:00:10:13  so that's where it quits.
00:00:10:13 - 00:00:12:19  But from today it doesn't. Hi.
00:00:12:19 - 00:00:14:21  I'm on the core services team.
00:00:14:21 - 00:00:19:06  I build the x402 payment flow, and I'm Jacob from the AI team.
00:00:19:06 - 00:00:22:06  I work to bring it to the Apify server.
00:00:22:06 - 00:00:25:09  Today we are going to show you an agent paying for web data
00:00:25:10 - 00:00:28:15  on a pay-per-use basis and how much it all costs.
00:00:28:18 - 00:00:33:14  It runs on x402, the open source payment protocol governed by Linux Foundation.
00:00:33:15 - 00:00:37:03  The agent makes a normal HTTP call to our actor API,
00:00:37:03 - 00:00:41:09  and the server responds with a 402 Payment Required status code.
00:00:41:10 - 00:00:45:05  The agent authorizes the transaction and, with the x402 schema,
00:00:45:05 - 00:00:49:08  it sets the allowance so you only pay for what the run actually consumed.
00:00:49:08 - 00:00:51:04  So this is what it looks like.
00:00:51:04 - 00:00:54:22  This is my droid agent and I will prompt it with something like this.
00:00:58:09 - 00:01:02:03  Now the agent will find it has the MCP CLI installed.
00:01:02:03 - 00:01:06:20  It's our custom-made MCP CLI client that has the MCP support built in.
00:01:07:02 - 00:01:11:06  Then it will check if it has balance in the agent wallet,
00:01:11:19 - 00:01:16:01  and also it will connect to the Apify server.
00:01:16:02 - 00:01:20:14  So now we see the agent has $5 USDC in the wallet
00:01:20:14 - 00:01:22:20  and now it's connecting to Apify.
00:01:22:20 - 00:01:24:09  Here is the important thing.
00:01:24:09 - 00:01:31:09  It's connecting with the --x402 flag, which tells the MCP client to use x402 payments.
00:01:31:10 - 00:01:34:13  And now it will search for the best actor.
00:01:34:14 - 00:01:38:15  It found the Clockworks TikTok hashtag scraper and now it will try to use the scraper.
00:01:38:15 - 00:01:43:19  So now it fetches all the details regarding the actor so it knows how to use it properly.
00:01:43:19 - 00:01:48:03  And then it will scrape 100 posts using the scraper.
00:01:48:05 - 00:01:51:16  Now the scraper is running on Apify. Let's wait for the results.
00:01:51:16 - 00:01:55:01  Now it is fetching the data and we have them saved locally.
00:01:55:01 - 00:01:59:00  It will write the script to process the data and analyze them to give us the summary.
00:01:59:00 - 00:02:04:09  Creating a Python script to analyze the JSON data. It successfully exported from Apify.
00:02:04:09 - 00:02:10:24  Now the script finished successfully and it summarizes the results. And now the results are here.
00:02:10:24 - 00:02:19:00  There are plenty of creators. There are four orders: engagement, likes, videos, and how many plays the videos have.
00:02:19:01 - 00:02:23:18  So that's it. We have the data saved locally and we have a summary from AI agents.
00:02:23:18 - 00:02:27:01  And we are ready to analyze the data and use it in our workflows.
00:02:27:02 - 00:02:33:12  That's thousands of AI tools on the Apify Store that your agent can access through x402.
00:02:33:12 - 00:02:40:08  And now the agent can export to enabled endpoints on agents that market on Apify.
00:02:40:09 - 00:02:44:24  We really believe in the agent economy and x402 is a critical piece of the infrastructure.
00:02:44:24 - 00:02:50:05  You can read our launch blog post and docs, and give your agent the power to pay.
